entries.note: The tracking page's script shows this status as its first step, dated by the consignment note: the booking branch has taken the goods in.
The page writes IN TRANSIT for this status, beside the leg the consignment is on.
The page's third step, dated when the delivery branch takes the consignment in.
The page's fourth step, dated by the delivery run sheet.
The page's last step, which opens the proof of delivery.
A manifest taking the consignment from one branch or hub to the next, by the reply's outward caption.
The arrival unloading sheet of a manifest, at the hub or branch it reached.
